title: Give the review file sidebar's sizing one owner

intentCoverage.report:
Dough Intent Coverage — Caught

Story: SEED-384#one-owner-for-the-review-file-sidebar-sizing (`.planning/seeds/SEED-384-keep-review-changes-focused-on-the-diff.md#one-owner-for-the-review-file-sidebar-sizing`), checked at `6cb6f27dcec9a7a47dcad70085acff56147abb08` (includes slice 2 lean specs at `c5b1d4a8de95d7531fcddff594876aae32dfb621`). Plan present: `.planning/slice-plans/699-one-owner-for-the-review-file-sidebar-sizing/PLAN.md`.

Promise (validated as suggested): Files divider specs keep proof of the review's own rules, and an unusable kept preference yields the review's 16rem default (not the shared equal-share panel default). Expected observable: with preferred width kept as `"wide"`, after reload/open the review file sidebar is 16rem wide.

Fault (scratch only): in `dashboard/src/reviewFileSidebarWidth.ts` `useFileSidebarWidth`, replaced `preferred ?? defaultFileSidebarWidthRem * room.rem` with `preferred`, so an unusable/unset preference no longer supplies the review's 16rem default and `shareOfRoom` falls through to equal share of the measured room. Fixtures and maintained assertions were left intact. Diff retained at `/tmp/dough-intent-coverage-SEED-384-fault.diff`.

Checkout: isolated detached worktree `/tmp/dough-intent-coverage-SEED-384-one-owner-sidebar-sizing-scratch` at the selected revision; execution worktree untouched. Pre-probe HEAD/status/diff recorded; after restore, product file SHA matched the original and scratch status matched pre-probe; worktree then removed. Setup used a temporary `node_modules` symlink from the convention worktree (removed before the final status match).

Maintained check examined: `dashboard/frontend-tests/review/story-review-files-divider-kept.spec.ts` — `an unusable kept file sidebar width gives 16rem` — `keepFilesWidth(page, "wide")`, `reloadAndOpenReview`, then `files.showsSidebarWidth(16 * rem)` (`dashboard/tests/filesDividerPage.ts:110`). Shared parsing in `dashboard/frontend-tests/navigation/side-panel-width-kept.spec.ts` was not treated as covering this 16rem default.

Runs (focused command under `caffeinate -s -i` on AC; Playwright line reporter; title filter above):
- Baseline: 1 passed (11.5s). Reach exercised: unusable `"wide"` → reload/open → 16rem assertion.
- Faulted: 1 failed. Assertion expected 256, received 331 (equal share of the ~662 px room; matches plan premise). Independently observed wrong behavior on the intended path: sidebar width was equal-share, not 16rem, and the maintained `showsSidebarWidth(16 * rem)` failed on that path.
- Restored: 1 passed (3.5s); scratch matched pre-probe.

Verdict: Caught. The maintained assertion `showsSidebarWidth(16 * rem)` in `an unusable kept file sidebar width gives 16rem` failed on the independently observed equal-share width after the unusable `"wide"` keep and reload.

Next proof action: None for this promise path — keep the maintained unusable→16rem assertion; no strengthening or new journey required from this probe. No already-planned repair or prior disposition matched; this is not a new repair decision.

Costs:
- **Test runtime.** Measured from Playwright summaries: baseline 11.5 s + faulted run (failed after ~5 s poll timeout; shell wall ~10.3 s) + restored 3.5 s ≈ 25.3 s reported / ~27.5 s wall for the three focused runs.
- **Human effort.** Unavailable. No separately supported human-time measure for this invocation.
- **Agent effort.** Estimated ~120 s wall for lookup, scratch setup, three focused runs, restore, and report prep (from invocation start through prepared body), not a separately billed agent metric.

- **Invocation-to-report elapsed.** 159841 ms (measured), from 1794993750622 to 1794993910463 in Unix epoch ms. The end clock was sampled after writing the prepared report body.
